label: A beginning of contingent reality is possible and no possible beginning has an external cause
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed: some accessible history satisfies the supplied beginning predicate with a contingent concrete individual, and no accessible history has such a beginning together with an existing concrete cause of the contingent totality outside all contingent concrete individuals. Replacement account: beginnings of contingent reality are brute; nothing outside it could have produced it. Classically the exact negation of the causal-opportunity premise.
